Mix & Move with AI - Educator's Experience

Self-paced Online Professional Learning

Post-Module Survey

Code.org relies on surveys as a crucial tool to stay connected to teachers, gather feedback about your learning experience, and to improve our products.

Privacy and Confidentiality

  • Your individual responses here are completely confidential.
  • Your identity will never be revealed publicly or used to tie any responses back to you personally.
  • We may share anonymous, aggregate data (representing all responses) publicly.
  • Your anonymized responses will be used by Code.org for product and program improvement.

Your honesty and candor are appreciated.
